input.question: When constructing the input map for `notification.api/create-notification!`, which keys are expected in the `::models.notification/FullyHydratedNotification` shaped map?

options.A: `:notification_type`, `:user_id`, `:card`, `:condition`, and `:first_only` — camel-cased versions of the alert API fields mapped to their notification equivalents.
options.B: `:type`, `:owner_id`, `:data`, `:recipients`, and `:channels` — these correspond to the internal channel model fields used by the notification system.
options.C: `:card_id`, `:channels`, `:alert_condition`, and `:alert_first_only` — the raw alert API request fields can be passed directly without transformation.
options.D: `:payload_type` (keyword), `:creator_id`, `:payload` (map with at minimum `:card_id`), `:subscriptions` (seq), and `:handlers` (seq) — the alert API request fields must be transformed into this notification shape.
